noise_policy: Scale matched on training fluid-entry RMS only; causal forward temporal innovations and value-independent column support. No future RMS matching.
selection_criterion: minimum noisy validation observed MSE, tie broken by declaration order; independent zero-mean validation noise is needed for an unbiased clean-risk interpretation
uncertainty_policy: mean/std/min/max across three noise seeds within matched case/noise groups, conditional on each deterministic flow; no confidence interval or broad generalization claim
postprocessing_policy: Geometry-only priors applied to validation and test predictions before scoring; periodic no-solid domains only; models are fitted once and shared across declared output variants. A dealiased persistence candidate separates filtering gains from dynamics.
